title: Databricks Personal access token: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: two-digit rotation suffix vs the single digit both pinned tools corroborate (gitleaks: (?:-\d)?; trufflehog: (-\d)?). Twin of "Databricks Personal access token: expected outcome not assertable (unresolved) [legacy tier T0]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. The outcome shows how the changed property is treated.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T0: the evidence is unresolved and the fixtures were unscored, so no outcome is asserted. Not asserted: disputed property — the -<digits> rotation suffix (its existence, digit count and place in the secret span). No provider-owned source decides it and the research pass recorded it as searched-and-not-found, so the benchmark stops asserting it (docs/decisions/2026-09-24-stop-asserting-provider-undecided-format-properties.md). Kept as history; the product's behaviour on this property is unmeasured for databricks-personal-access-token.
